requirements.description: Good honours degree in computing; OR good honours in a related discipline + 2 years IT industry experience; OR good bachelor's in computing + 2 years IT experience; OR good bachelor's/honours in a business-related discipline + 2 years IT experience. IELTS minimum 6.0 overall. No component minimum stated.

GRE minimum 320 (verbal & quantitative) and 3.5 analytical, OR GMAT 650+. GRE/GMAT valid 5 years, TOEFL/IELTS 2 years. FAQ: GRE/GMAT not mandatory; a good score strengthens the application — missing GRE/GMAT is UNKNOWN, never NOT_MET.
